title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode2 The Real Business Deal

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: A few days later
HeartUp Creation Headquarters

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
These are their headquarters...!
I'm starting to feel kinda anxious.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like it's almost showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do you think we're gonna do today?
I hope we get to talk to lots of their employees.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And plan our own event!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get why you two are excited, but you need to settle down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The employee in charge of guiding us is gonna be here soon. You don't wanna cause them trouble, do you?

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: There's no need to be so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
Thank you very much for coming all this way.
My name is Kizaki. I'll be your guide today.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: I look forward to showing you around today!

rows.Speaker: Student Leader
rows.Line: Yes, thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll begin by explaining today's agenda.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: First, I'll give you all an overview of what this company does, from our mission statement to our actual business model.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll give you a tour of the office.
Finally, to cap things off, we'll be asking you all to do a group exercise.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A group exercise?

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Yes, we'll have you sit down and actually plan out an event proposal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to plan an event? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: What kind of event do you think it's gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so excited to find out!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: We'll give you the details when we get to the activity, so I hope you'll look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Anyway, if there are no further questions, then I'd like to begin explaining what this company does.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Thank you!
A few hours later
Meeting room

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
That concludes the tour of the office.
What did you all think?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Getting to watch real meetings as they took place was so educational!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought everyone was gonna act all super serious, but they seemed to have a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think what she's trying to say is that things were much more relaxed than we initially expected...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: We value having engaging discussions during our meetings. In particular, when presenting new ideas, we try to be as frank as possible with each other.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: So, for the groupwork activity, we're hoping that you'll all do the same.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be holding the activity here, so please break off into groups of three or four.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Saki, Shiho, let's form a group!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Alright, now that you've all found your seats, I'd like to announce the event you'll be working on today...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: It will be a product promotion event for a stationery company.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(A product promotion event...
Does that mean it's gonna be like that cosmetics expo?)

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: I should also mention that this event is based on a real deal we have with our client, Saishi Kobo. They have graciously given us permission to run this activity.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: So, please treat the information you hear today with the utmost care.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
You will have ninety minutes.
Once you've wrapped up your discussions, you'll give presentations to some of our employees. I wish you all the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, we're giving presentations at the end...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She did say it's based on an actual deal they have with another company. Things just got pretty real.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We'll have to do our best to come up with a wonderhoy event!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Finally, to get your discussions to proceed smoothly...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: First, you'll want to read through the documents we've provided on our client, Saishi Kobo. They include the company's mission statement and details regarding a number of their products.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Once you've read those, you should proceed with discussing how you're actually going to promote their products at this event.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: We'll be walking around to monitor your progress. Please feel free to ask us for help if you get stuck. Your time begins... Now.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, we're done reading about the company! Let's begin discussing our event!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We're probably supposed to jot down our ideas on this whiteboard, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Each team gets one, and we've been told to use them however we like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is starting to feel like a real planning meeting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see. We're supposed to come up with ideas based on Saishi Kobo's mission statement and the key characteristics of their products, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Their mission statement describes what they want to do as a company and stuff, right? In other words, it talks about the things they care about most.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. At the top of their mission statement, it says, “Helping you send your thoughts”...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that means telling others how you feel through message cards and stuff. They've got a number of stationery products for that purpose.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see...
Which means the event we plan should revolve around the idea of “helping you send your thoughts”, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Also, we have information here saying that the event itself is going to take place in a mall at the beginning of March...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It looks like they're going to be releasing a new line of message cards sometime during the month, so this event likely coincides with that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, do you think the cards are these ones that were with the printouts?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, look! They say “sample” on them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, this card is silky smooth!
I really like this texture...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm tempted to keep rubbing it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, it says, “We achieved this delightfully silky texture by using a special pulp mixture.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These cards apparently come in all sorts of colors with different patterns. Check out this page. It has pictures of all of them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! They're all so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess a big lineup will help people find exactly what they're looking for in a message card.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes sense... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have an idea! What if our event involved having people make actual message cards using these?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Using these?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! By actually using the products, they'll get to experience this amazing texture firsthand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And having a huge variety to choose from means getting to have fun deciding what kind of card fits most perfectly for the person they're sending it to.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not a bad idea. But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Isn't that a little weak, as far as product promotion goes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I used to write letters when I was little, but everyone just messages each other on social media now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you're gonna have a hard time convincing people to write out messages by literally putting pen to paper.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I like writing letters and stuff, but not everyone feels the same way as me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. So, we need to come up with a way to catch the interest of those people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
What would get them to stop and say, “I wanna make one!”...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
My head's starting to hurt...
I didn't realize planning an event would be this hard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's just so much we have to think about...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: During the meeting we got to observe earlier, everyone threw out all the ideas they could to make sure their products brought smiles to a wide market.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which means we have to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we think more about the guests we want to attract to our event?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About the guests...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! The employees said they think about stuff like how old their guests are, what they like, and what they like to do and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think we'll be able to come up with better ideas if we do the same thing and think about the people☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
That could make things a lot easier for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Otori.
Let's give your idea a try.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First, this event's being held at a mall, so it's safe to say that most people will be there to get some shopping done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it's taking place at the beginning of March... What do you think they'll be there to buy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Rice puffs for the Doll Festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That might be too specific.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shopping at a mall... In March...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think I know the answer!
